name: Mockup Kit

release.copyRule: Version 2.6.0 is publicly available in the US Mac App Store, verified on 2026-11-21. Describe the maintained source-backed capabilities as available; do not infer availability in every storefront.

pricing.pricingSource: Current App Store purchase sheet; prices and introductory offers vary by storefront and eligibility.
pricing.copyRule: Do not present a monthly introductory trial as the only way to try the app or hardcode one storefront price as universal.

capabilities.title: Screenshot mockups
details: Import iPhone captures and choose from multiple portrait canvas presets.
Compose device framing, backgrounds, gradients, multiline headlines, and image overlays.
Adjust fonts, colors, image placement, and rounded corners.
Export the selected screenshot as PNG or JPEG.

capabilities.title: Screenshot workspace
details: Arrange up to ten screenshot boards in a workspace.

capabilities.title: Headers & Search Results studio
details: Create Header, Search Results, and Universal image assets.
Start with six editable category templates: productivity/utilities, health/fitness/wellness, finance/business, AI/developer tools/SaaS, social/lifestyle/entertainment, and games.
Edit image, text, card, badge, and ring layers; move, resize, rotate, reorder, hide, and lock layers.
Use undo/redo and sync background and typography from a screenshot board.
Extend language-specific text/images and localized batch export to the new creative scenes.

capabilities.title: Illustrative store preview
details: Preview artwork inside mock search and product page layouts.
Edit app icon, name, subtitle, and rating for the preview.
Art-safe and crop guides are editor aids excluded from exported artwork.
Preview is illustrative, not a live Apple listing or approval guarantee.

capabilities.title: Screenshot localization and batch export
details: Keep screenshot headlines and image variants by language.
Preview right-to-left and expanded test layouts.
Export completed screenshot localizations as JPEG into locale folders with consistent filenames.
Track batch progress, cancel work, and retry unfinished exports without replacing successful files.

capabilities.title: Opaque creative export and preflight
details: Export creative assets as opaque RGB images without an alpha channel.
Check missing content, translations, text overflow, dimensions, and formats.
Preflight does not guarantee Apple acceptance or verify legal ownership of imported artwork.

capabilities.title: Screenshot preflight and opaque output
details: Render screenshot compositions as opaque RGB images.
Check missing or unreadable screenshots and overlays, missing device frames or translations, title overflow, clipped overlays, and duplicate export filenames.
Selected screenshot export supports PNG/JPEG; screenshot Export All produces JPEG files.

capabilities.title: Rounded Image
details: Apply rounded corners to a standalone image in pixels or percentage.
Export the finished image as PNG.

constraints: Composition and export run locally on the Mac.
Projects remain in memory during the current app session; saving and reopening project files is not yet available.
Header/Search creative placements are optional for iOS/iPadOS 27+ apps and games; they are not macOS listing placements.
App Store screenshots and optional creative assets are separate asset types with different requirements.
Mockup Kit is not affiliated with Apple Inc.
Do not claim conversion improvements, ratings, testimonials, review approval, cloud sync, AI generation, or persistent project storage without independently verified evidence.
